about: Xcel division tables the planner scores UCG's Xcel levels with: value parts required, difficulty limits, special requirements and the vault chart. Own words: the special requirements are paraphrased from the Xcel event rules charts; numbers and element numbers as printed. Divisions: silver, gold, plat (Platinum), diamond, sapphire. Moved here from the planner's js/data/xcel.js on 2026-10-21 unchanged (not re-checked against the Code then); the planner now generates xcel.js from this file.
source: USAG Xcel Code of Points 2022-2028, each event's rules chart and the vault chart; UCG Women's Rules v6.0 §II.B-F (Google Doc, source of record) for UCG's changes

value_parts.about: value parts required per event, highest first; a higher value part can fill a lower requirement
value_parts.cite: Xcel CoP event rules charts, Value Parts row, by division

limits.about: highest letter allowed per event without the restricted-skill deduction (0.50); maxCount = how many of the top letter are allowed; note = the chart's other limits, paraphrased
limits.cite: Xcel CoP Difficulty Restrictions charts, by division; sapphire: UCG Women's Rules §II.B.1 (no difficulty restrictions, no limit on Ds or Es)

vaults.about: code = USAG vault number. gold: allowed at Gold (10.0, or 9.5 with the alternative springboard); plat/diamond/sapphire: start value; a division missing from a row doesn't allow that vault
vaults.cite: Xcel CoP vault chart (as current through Aug 2025); Gold springboard 9.5: UCG Women's Rules §II.E.3; Sapphire also allows Level 9/10 vaults at 10.0 (§II.B.2, not listed here)
